lines.text: Next is a great one from Fiona MacLeod, who wrote it on a rainy weekend in Glasgow, I am told.
A band called a- ha is up next, and yes, we are playing the big one from the eighties.
This one is called Manhat10, and it sounds like a long walk through the city after midnight.
Our next artist is Siobhan Cavanaugh, and her new record has been on repeat around here all week.
